description: Implementation of polar coding algorithms, including generation of mother codes, interleavers, and code parameter setup for polar codes in a telecommunications context.

classes.name: polar_code_impl
classes.description: Class implementing polar coding algorithms, including code parameter setup, code generation, and interleaving for different code lengths.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Configures the polar code parameters including K, E, nMax, and ibil, and prepares the code sets and frozen bits.

methods.name: get_n
methods.description: Returns the current value of n, the code length exponent.

methods.name: get_N
methods.description: Returns the total code length N.

methods.name: get_K
methods.description: Returns the number of information bits K.

methods.name: get_E
methods.description: Returns the rate-matched codeword length E.

methods.name: get_nPC
methods.description: Returns the number of parity check bits nPC.

methods.name: get_K_set
methods.description: Returns the bitset representing the set of information and parity bits.

methods.name: get_PC_set
methods.description: Returns the set of parity check bits.

methods.name: get_blk_interleaver
methods.description: Returns the block interleaver pattern for the current n.

methods.name: get_mother_code
methods.description: Returns the mother code pattern for a given n (5 to 10).

methods.name: setdiff_stable
methods.description: Computes the difference between two sets, excluding elements present in the second set, with a threshold T.

methods.name: set_code_params
methods.description: Sets internal parameters for the polar code, including K, E, nMax, and computes derived parameters.
